references.text: Abraham circumcised Isaac when he was eight days old, as God had commanded him
All the men in Abraham's household, both those born there and those bought with money from foreigners, were circumcised along with him
On the eighth day, the flesh of the foreskin shall be circumcised
When eight days had passed and the child was to be circumcised, he was named Jesus
Stephen refers to the covenant of circumcision that God made with Abraham
Abraham received the sign of circumcision as a seal on the righteousness he had by faith while still uncircumcised
Paul says about himself that he was circumcised on the eighth day, of the stock of Israel
